cases.title: Restaurant operations and ERP design
cases.status: Implemented prototype mechanisms inspected; current deployment and business outcomes not freshly verified
cases.summary: The restaurant ERP source implements an invoice-extraction endpoint with authenticated tenant and manager-role checks, an AI budget precheck and tracked vision-model calls. It returns extracted supplier, reference, date, total and line fields for review. Separate operational functions cover daily close and rule-based specialist reviews.
mechanisms_documented: Invoice image extraction followed by human review
Daily summaries covering sales, expenses, inventory and shifts
Specialist finance, roster, marketing and daily-close roles
Natural-language historical queries backed by dated records
Task and agent action markers rendered as interface controls
mechanisms_verified: AI spend precheck and usage-tracked Gemini vision call
Image or PDF inputs and restricted Storage URL fetching
JSON extraction with basic numeric and string coercion
Structured error responses for parsing or model failures
cases.attribution: The repository README links Haris88m/smash-hq. This supports association with Haris's project repository; it does not establish sole manual authorship or restaurant ownership.
cases.application_use: A source-inspected AI-assisted ERP prototype case. Do not claim strict schema enforcement, confidence-score escalation, production reliability or measured business outcomes.

cases.title: Operational manuals and structured document generation
cases.status: Source code and output artifacts inspected
cases.summary: Python scripts combine structured recipe records, a product image manifest and operational text into formatted PDF manuals. Separate scripts extract PDF images and parse public menu records. The operating manual leaves local settings and management approval explicit rather than treating draft values as validated practice.
mechanisms_verified: Structured recipe data transformed into printable pages
PDF image extraction and contact-sheet creation
Management-confirmation fields retained in operational procedures
cases.attribution: Code and artifacts exist; Haris personal authorship and live business use require separate attribution evidence.
cases.application_use: Do not attach confidential originals. A neutral transformed demonstration can explain the document-production pattern.

cases.title: Project Signal
cases.status: Research and governance blueprint; no application implementation authorized
cases.summary: Project Signal structures a pharmacy-access concept into sourced research, assumptions, decision records, feature evaluations, service hypotheses and implementation-readiness gates. Its current records hold application development pending further research and qualified review.
mechanisms_verified: JSON schemas for risks, research items, decisions and feature candidates
Explicit separation of unverified hypotheses from approved requirements
cases.application_use: A research and requirements-governance case, not an automated pharmacy network, live partner outreach or adopted health platform.
